info.name: ManageBizz API smoke test
info.description: Five-request local smoke test: register, propose a task, approve it, inspect the completed run, and inspect its trace. Uses the mock agent parser and an in-memory task service.

request.description: Creates a fresh local test account and saves its JWT as the collection variable `token`. Requires MongoDB to be available.

exec: pm.test('registration returned a token', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Starts the real application-level agent run. The task should be proposed and await approval; it must not execute yet.

exec: pm.test('task proposal is present', function () { pm.expect(body.runId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(proposal).to.exist; });

request.description: Approves the pending proposal. The response should contain the successfully executed and verified task entity.

exec: pm.test('approval and execution succeeded', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('run completed after approval', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('completed'); });

pm.test('task mutation is verified', function () { pm.expect(proposal).to.exist; pm.expect(proposal.lifecycle).to.eql('VERIFIED'); pm.expect(proposal.result.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(proposal.result.data.task.status).to.eql('OPEN'); pm.expect(proposal.result.data.task.title).to.eql('Postman smoke test task'); });

request.description: Reads the saved application-level run result, including its answer, evidence, action lifecycle, and trace.

exec: pm.test('completed result is available', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.runId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('completed'); pm.expect(body.answer).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Checks structured observability events for this run, including task proposal, approval, tool execution, verification, and run completion.

exec: pm.test('trace records completed action lifecycle', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.trace.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(types).to.include('ACTION_PROPOSED'); pm.expect(types).to.include('ACTION_APPROVED'); pm.expect(types).to.include('ACTION_EXECUTED'); pm.expect(types).to.include('ACTION_VERIFIED'); pm.expect(types).to.include('AGENT_COMPLETED'); });
